definitions.explanation: A horizontal sheet or thickness of material, especially one of several lying on top of one another. Used in geology, architecture, and other fields.
A section of society or a category of people sharing common characteristics such as age, income, or interests. Often used as a suffix.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地|ち}{層|そう}→地層：06366_chisou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何層|なんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重|かさ}なっている→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧。
examples.english: The geological strata are layered many levels deep.

examples.japanese: ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三層|さんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねた→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
examples.english: I stacked the cake in three layers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧{層|そう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: A stratum containing fossils is clearly visible in this rock.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{層|そう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It's popular among the younger demographic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{富裕|ふゆう}{層|そう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ターゲット→ターゲット：11036_taagetto⟧にした⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a product targeting the wealthy class.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{年齢層|ねんれいそう}→年齢層：25966_nenreisou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This program is supported by a wide range of age groups.

notes:
USAGE:
As a standalone noun, {層|そう} most commonly refers to physical layers. As a suffix attached to demographic or social descriptors, it indicates a group or segment: ⟦{年齢層|ねんれいそう}→年齢層：25966_nenreisou⟧ (age group), ⟦{富裕層|ふゆうそう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧ (wealthy class), ⟦{若年層|じゃくねんそう}→若年層：20942_jakunensou⟧ (young demographic).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地層|ちそう}→地層：06366_chisou⟧: geological stratum
- ⟦{年齢層|ねんれいそう}→年齢層：25966_nenreisou⟧: age group
- ⟦{富裕層|ふゆうそう}→富裕層：12390_fuyuusou⟧: wealthy class
- ⟦{若年層|じゃくねんそう}→若年層：20942_jakunensou⟧: young demographic
- {高齢層|こうれいそう}: elderly demographic
- ⟦{中間層|ちゅうかんそう}→中間層：19867_chuukansou⟧: middle class
- ～{層|そう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧: popular among ~ demographic
